data.title: Heavy rain triggers floods in northern provinces
data.description: Heavy rain has caused flooding in Mae Hong Son and Nakhon Phanom, damaging farmland, roads and riverside homes as forecasters warn of more heavy rain and possible flash floods.

data.title: Myanmar keen to revive trade links
data.description: Thailand and Myanmar are seeking to revive border trade and ease barriers, following years of disruption, the Department of Foreign Trade (DoFT) says.

data.title: Durian exports pass 2025  total despite rising costs
data.description: Thailand has exported more than 1.11 million tonnes of durians so far this year, surpassing last year's total despite higher production, transport costs and intensifying competition.

data.title: Govt eyes stronger cyber defences as data leaks raise alarm
data.description: Government agencies will consider adopting multi-factor authentication (MFA) and resetting passwords following data leaks that exposed sensitive information from at least 20 state agencies.

data.title: Parties ready censure motion
data.description: The opposition will file a no-confidence motion against the government in the next parliamentary session, with alleged collusion in the Senate election among the issues it plans to raise.

data.title: Shooter used online guides
data.description: The 14-year-old student who carried out the deadly shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School studied how to use firearms online for one to two years prior to the attack, police say.

data.title: Spikers keep clean record in second leg
data.description: Thailand finished the second leg of the 2026 SEA V Cup in Chiang Mai with a perfect record after defeating Southeast Asian rivals Vietnam 3-0 (25-20, 25-10, 25-15) on Sunday.

data.title: War Elephants top the charts
data.description: Thailand secured top spot in Group B of the Asean Hyundai Cup on Saturday, beating Myanmar 2-0 in Bangkok to book a semi-final meeting with four-time champions Singapore.

data.title: Students, teachers mourn girl killed in Thailand school shooting
data.description: BANGKOK - Dozens of bereaved students, parents and teachers queued at a Buddhist temple in Thailand on Sunday to pray over the body of a 12-year-old girl, one of eight victims of a home and school shooting two days earlier.

data.title: Typhoon Dolphin makes landfall in China after flight cancellations, evacuations
data.description: BEIJING - Typhoon Dolphin made landfall in densely populated eastern China on Sunday, meteorological authorities said, after the storm triggered more than 1,000 flight cancellations, evacuations and a top-level alert.

data.title: Police cite multiple factors in deadly school shooting
data.description: The deadly attack by a student at Debsirin Nonthaburi School appears to have resulted from a combination of factors such as family problems, issues at school, academic pressure, conflicts with friends and exposure to violent online content, a senior police officer said on Sunday.

data.title: Benz driver caught with 'ice' under the bonnet
data.description: SAMUT SONGKHRAM - Police arrested a woman after finding one kilogramme of crystal methamphetamine, aka “ice”, hidden under the bonnet of her Mercedes-Benz and a pistol on the back seat, in Muang district early Sunday morning.

data.title: ONE Championship: Masaaki Noiri promises Siasarani KO next after avenging Liu loss
data.description: Masaaki Noiri has promised to knock out Mohammad Siasarani in the ONE Samurai featherweight kickboxing tournament semi-finals before completing a route back to Superbon and the ONE Championship world title.

data.title: Iran Guards say won't reopen Hormuz without US meeting all Tehran's conditions
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Sunday they would not reopen the Strait of Hormuz, vital to the world economy, until the United States met Tehran's conditions set out the day before, including compensation for war damages.

data.title: Man found shot dead after killing his girlfriend
data.description: NAKHON SI THAMMARAT - A man was found shot dead outside his home in Muang district of this southern province early Sunday morning, after allegedly killing his girlfriend on Friday.

data.title: Indonesia closes national park as wildfire spreads
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesian authorities have closed access to a national park on Java Island as firefighters battle a wildfire raging there for nearly a week.

data.title: BLACKPINK anniversary puts Thai art show in spotlight
data.description: An Amazing Thailand exhibition in Seoul gained online attention after its sign appeared behind BLACKPINK’s 10th-anniversary fan event.

data.title: Nakhon Phanom flooded, South on alert
data.description: NAKHON PHANOM - Overnight downpours left submerged roads and inundated homes and businesses in this northeastern border province on Sunday, prompting emergency drainage operations.

data.title: ZXMoto leads China's charge to dominate the global motorbike market
data.description: CHONGQING, China - Zhang Xue wept with joy and furiously waved a Chinese flag as he watched his company's superbike scream across the finish line four seconds ahead of competitors in only its third world championship race.

data.title: Iran issues demands for reopening of Hormuz
data.description: DUBAI - Iran set preconditions on Saturday for a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, including compensation for war damages, complicating a potential deal to open the waterway essential to the world economy.

data.title: Japan nuclear debate unnerves proponents of pacifism
data.description: TOKYO - As Japan marks the anniversary of the 1945 atomic bombs, its leaders are pushing for a renewed debate on nuclear weapons in a challenge to the nation's long-time pacifist stance.

data.title: Afghanistan's gold rush upends lives and landscapes
data.description: SHIWA MINE, Afghanistan - In Afghanistan's northeastern Badakhshan province, dozens of excavators operate day and night to extract gold from the mountains where villagers and their livestock once roamed.

data.title: School closes classes after sacked foreign teacher’s threat
data.description: SONGKHLA - The management of Hatyaiwittayalai secondary school in this southern province announced it will close its gates on Monday and Tuesday and provide online lessons after a sacked foreign teacher posted a firearm threat.

data.title: School goes on-line after former foreign teacher’s threat
data.description: SONGKHLA: The management of Hatyaiwittayalai School in this southern province will close its gates on Monday and Tuesday and provide online services after a former foreign teacher posed a firearm threat.

data.title: FIFA condemns 'concerted and ongoing effort' to weaken Infantino
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA on Saturday condemned "a concerted and ongoing effort by some to undermine" the world game's governing body and its president Gianni Infantino as the controversy over his now shelved private investment plan rumbles on.

data.title: Pattarapon seals first TDT victory in 3-way playoff
data.description: Pattarapon Losathapornpipit won the one-million-baht Singha–SAT TDT Nakhon Nayok 2026 in a three-way playoff at the par-71 Royal Hill Golf Resort & Spa in Nakhon Nayok on Friday.

data.title: Driver injures 20 kids
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Police have charged a 54-year-old driver with five offences after his car crashed into a child development centre in Muang district, injuring 20 children.

data.title: Amlo eyes 200 in exam fraud probe
data.description: The government has widened its local-government exam fraud probe, with the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) tracing the financial transactions of more than 200 people involved in the network.

data.title: Thai InterPride head urges global solidarity
data.description: InterPride's first Thai transgender co-president has warned that global LGBTQ+ rights are at a critical crossroads, urging solidarity against rising hatred.

data.title: Hospital graft claims 'unproven'
data.description: The Ministry of Public Health has rejected claims of widespread corruption involving health promotion and prevention funds at community hospitals.

data.title: Na Ladprao beer hall owner charged over fatal fire
data.description: Police have charged the owner of Na Ladprao beer hall with six offences following a fire last month that killed 37 people and injured 77 others.

data.title: Court halts delay of Social Security poll
data.description: The Central Administrative Court has ordered a temporary suspension of an announcement postponing the Social Security Board election, clearing the way for the poll to proceed until the court issues a final ruling.

data.title: Down with the death penalty?
data.description: A series of grisly murders has reignited one of the country's most enduring and divisive public debates: whether the death penalty remains necessary to protect society or whether the justice system should instead focus on improving law enforcement, rehabilitation and post-release supervision.

data.title: No signs of bullying: witness
data.description: The public should avoid speculating that bullying had triggered the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Nonthaburi's Bang Kruai district, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.
